evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: game creation. Name and description are attributes of that feature.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: inviting estimators via a URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: starting a round by entering an item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: viewing the item list.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single selection feature; re-estimation is the same selection action for a previously estimated item.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: adding an item.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: editing an item.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: deleting an item.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: immediate display of estimates.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: accepting the average estimate.

evaluations.evidence: have the estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single convenience feature: automatic estimate field population.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: entering the agreed estimate.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: re-estimating a prior story.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: spreadsheet import.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: spreadsheet copy/paste entry.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: browsing previous games.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: viewing a game transcript.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: HTML export.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: CSV export.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: game deletion.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: account creation. The entered fields are attributes of that feature.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: login.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: account details update.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: account deletion.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: local timezone display.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: password reminder.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single configuration feature: choosing the estimation scale.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: inviting estimators with a limit.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: joining a game.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: viewing the current estimation item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: viewing the session item list.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: visibly indicating estimator progress.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: synchronized reveal of estimates.

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: changing an estimate before reveal.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: viewing prior estimates for an item.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: viewing current round estimate attribution.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: starting a shared countdown timer.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: automatic timer reset.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: viewing prior round history.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: consistent card ordering.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: estimate modification before draw completion.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: displaying participant thumbnails.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single standards-compliance feature; XHTML and CSS are aspects of that compliance.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: a glossary of terms.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single performance feature: database indexing.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single cross-browser compatibility feature; the browsers are enumerated target environments.

evaluations.evidence: comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: accessibility compliance.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single performance feature: responsiveness.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: Unicode support.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single UX feature: predictable URLs.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: friendly error pages.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single privacy feature: non-identifiable storage.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature: usage metrics visibility.
